test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following won the Meltwater Champions Chess Tour 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Magnus Carlsen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Magnus Carlsen **secured the **overall Meltwater Champions Chess Tour title for the second consecutive year, confirming his win even with one event left.**
 
• He earned a **$50,000 prize from the Aimchess Rapid semi-finals, **increasing his total tour winnings to **$192,500 and earning the title of 2022 Tour Champion.**
 
• **Norwegian Magnus Carlsen is currently the world number 1 in chess and is pursuing a third consecutive tournament victory in the tour's penultimate event.**
 
• Polish player Jan-Krzysztof Duda was the only competitor who could have challenged Carlsen's lead but required Indian teen Arjun Erigaisi to eliminate Carlsen and win the final Major of the season.
 
• In the quarter-finals, Carlsen faced significant competition from Erigaisi, who initially led the game with three pawns more than Carlsen.
 
• **Despite Erigaisi's early lead, Carlsen used his endgame skills to recover, eventually forcing a draw after a marathon 137 moves.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Meltwater Champions Chess Tour **is a series of** online chess tournaments featuring many of the world's top players.**
 
• The tour includes several types of events, such as regular tournaments,** "majors", and a final tournament, with different point values assigned to each for determining the overall tour standings.**
 
• Each event in the tour is hosted on the chess platform **chess24, and games are live-streamed with commentary for viewers to watch in real-time.**
 
• **With substantial cash prizes and a high level of competition, the Meltwater Champions Chess Tour is considered one of the premier events in online chess.**
